desc:
🌟 OBBY TO HEAVEN! 🌟

Start in the Underworld. Finish above the clouds. Can you make it all the way to Heaven?

🔥 Escape the lava-filled UNDERWORLD
🦴 Climb across ancient bones in the DESERT
🐙 Find your footing in the OCEAN
🌈 Brave the rainbow paths of the SKY
✨ Reach HEAVEN… and discover what’s waiting for you!


⭐ 120 stages on one massive spiral climb
⭐ Different obstacles in every world
⭐ Tougher challenges the higher you go
⭐ Checkpoints save your progress along the way!


☁️ THE CLIMB IS ONLY THE BEGINNING…
Earn your first halo, then climb again to unlock more rewards! Collect a Cloud Fox, Sunrise Trail, Seraph Wings, and the Starglider across your first 5 finishes.
Heaven has a few more surprises… but you’ll have to reach it to see them. 👀

💛 Bring a friend and see who reaches the top first!
👍 Enjoying the climb? Like and ⭐ favorite to support the game!
